summary.tldr: Clarifies when someone is exploiting another person for Criminal Code trafficking in persons offences and repeals one related subsection.
what_it_does: Replaces the Criminal Code definition of exploitation for trafficking offences, saying it applies when someone causes another person to provide or offer labour or a service through force, coercion, fraud, deception, abuse of trust, power or authority, or a similar act.
Repeals subsection 279.04(2) of the Criminal Code.
who_it_affects: People accused of trafficking in persons
People who are exploited for labour or services
summary.background: The bill changes the definition of exploitation used for trafficking in persons offences in sections 279.01 to 279.03 of the Criminal Code.
